name: ai-assessment-assistant-desktop
description: Teacher desktop shell for assessment and assignment workflows.

scripts.electron:dev: npm run assessment:build && npm run assignment:build && electron .
scripts.electron:assignment: npm run assessment:build && npm run assignment:build && APP_MODE=assignment electron .
scripts.electron:pack: npm run assessment:build && npm run assignment:build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.electron:dist: npm run dmg:background && npm run assessment:build && npm run assignment:build && electron-builder
scripts.build:mac: npm run dmg:background && npm run assessment:build && npm run assignment:build && electron-builder --mac --dir && bash scripts/create-dmg-mac.sh
scripts.build:mac:app: npm run assessment:build && npm run assignment:build && electron-builder --mac --dir
scripts.build:windows: npm run assessment:build && npm run assignment:build && electron-builder --win --x64
